prose_items.item: [2.3] flat spacetimes are (Isom(M^n), M^n)-manifolds; existence of the developing map and the holonomy morphism

hypotheses.note: not used for dev, hol, uniqueness; ConnectedSpace M only for flat_developing_descends
not used; encoded in isom d (linear part in SO0(1,d))
LocPathConnectedSpace M (ChartedSpace.locPathConnectedSpace) and SemilocallySimplyConnected M (new: semilocallySimplyConnected_of_chartedSpace, charts onto convex balls), so no hypothesis is added

findings: l.486: the model group is typeset `Isom(M^n)` (plain M), elsewhere `Isom({\bf M}^n)`; typographic only.

§2.3 needs no topological hypothesis on M beyond the (G,X)-atlas: local path-connectedness and semilocal simple connectedness follow from the model being a normed space, and dev/hol/uniqueness need neither connectedness nor Hausdorffness of M.

Wave 2 (Flat/Quotient): no HasGroupoid (U : Opens (Minkowski d)) (gxGroupoid (isom d) (Minkowski d)) instance is synthesized (gxGroupoid not shown ClosedUnderRestriction), so these theorems do not yet apply to an open Ω ⊆ M^n with its subspace atlas; recorded in SCOPE (c).
questions: The flat structure of the universal cover is a reducible def (flatCoverChartedSpace d M x0) used through `letI`, mirroring the port's coverChartedSpace; it is not a global instance. If gx/§8 prefer an instance on UniversalCover M x0, that is a one-line change for the master session to rule on (an instance would fire for every ChartedSpace (Minkowski d) M).

kb_proposals: ChartedSpace's model is an outParam: a lemma `[ChartedSpace (Minkowski d) M] : P M` whose conclusion does not mention d silently drops d and the instance from its signature (section variables); give d and the instance as explicit binders.

A space charted over a real normed space is SemilocallySimplyConnected (ported sense): Causal.semilocallySimplyConnected_of_chartedSpace — loop in chart⁻¹(ball), Convex.contractibleSpace on the ball subtype, Path.Homotopic.map by e.symm, then pathCast.
